create_scale_factor_module: create a ScaleFactor nn.Module to scale tensor activations by a learned factor
fit_scale_factor_from_stats: fit a ScaleFactor by computing variance ratio between input and output tensors
observe_tensor_variances: observe input and reference tensor variances during a fit context to collect statistics
set_scale_factor_value: set the scale factor value directly on a fitted or unfitted ScaleFactor module
reset_scale_factor: reset a ScaleFactor module by zeroing its scale factor parameter
